name: § 1, after point aj – 62
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly
part_text: (ajc) condemn all forms of external interference that violate the sovereignty and political independence of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, in particular the imposition of unilateral coercive measures not authorised by the UN Security Council; urge states to refrain from adopting or maintaining unilateral sanctions contrary to international law and the UN Charter; strongly condemn the forcible abduction and unlawful removal from office of the President of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, Nicolás Maduro, as a grave violation of national sovereignty, the principle of self-determination and the UN Charter; deplore the EU’s weak and inadequate response and its failure to activate relevant UN mechanisms, including calls for independent investigations by the UN Security Council; warn that such inaction risks seriously undermining the foundations of the UN system and eroding the credibility of the rules-based international order; call for the withdrawal of recognition of any imposed authorities and for full support for the restoration of constitutional order, rejecting any form of external interference; support an inclusive political dialogue led by Venezuelans themselves and facilitated by impartial multilateral mechanisms, with full respect for the principle of non-intervention;
